name: sr-corporate-income-tax
description: Suriname income tax on companies and other bodies (inkomstenbelasting voor lichamen), tax year 2026, under the Wet Inkomstenbelasting 1922 as amended, with the Wet Dividendbelasting 1973. Covers which bodies are taxed (NV, co-operatives, mutual insurers, foundations and associations that run a business, statutory bodies), resident and non-resident bodies, the flat 36% rate, the taxable amount (belastbaar bedrag) from profit by sound business practice, non-deductible items (profit distributions, director profit shares above the caps, non-arm's-length related-party interest, income tax), the participation exemption, start-up losses and the seven-year loss carry-forward, the pension reserve, the permanent establishment rules, the 25% dividend tax and its exemptions, the provisional return within two and a half months with quarterly instalments, the definitive return within six months (30 June) in the online portal, penalties and interest. Trigger on: Suriname corporate tax, vennootschapsb
